items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: That’s what I got from Sun Ra’s band.

ctx.x: That’s a great memory. And I had the pleasure of talking with Marshall Allen and he’s quite a spirit. At the end he said something like I’ve been doing this for fifty years I’m still waiting to make some money.

Yeah. Well money wasn’t the center, play with Sunny. No. Forget that. But the music and the vibe and the people, the experience, that was it. And what I learned from him is that you know it’s not all about money. It’s just what are you going to learn from this? You know? How are you going to become better as a person, as a musician, just a better being © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
from being a part of this? That’s what we have to look for. You know? That’s what I got from Sun Ra’s band.
